_meta.notes: Form titled '2020 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' filed for the 2024 cycle (Interim, April 5 box checked; signed 4/5/24) - form_year is the printed title, never the cycle. Index priors confirmed at the page (Srivastava / Treasurer / 2024-04-05). Cover 'Office' cell is blank; Office Sought 'County Treasurer', District 'County'. Donor 'Complete Mailing Address' cells bar-redacted on every Schedule A page (city/state blank throughout); the bar also clips the tail of long donor names and the left edge of two long occupation strings - visible glyphs transcribed verbatim, nothing extracted from beneath any bar. In-kind treatment settled from the document's own arithmetic: each schedule lists one $100.00 in-kind row that its printed subtotals and grand total exclude, and Summary lines 1/2 include them - both anchors reported in recon. Three date oddities kept verbatim/blank per contract (rows 20, 25, 57). Schedule B rows are not date-ordered overall (pages run 03/27..02/20 then 03/06..01/31); printed order preserved in line_no.

contributions.detail: 93 rows sum 10,513.15 = Summary line 1 Column A. schedule-total-vs-summary-gap: the schedule's printed grand total 10,413.15 and the page subtotals EXCLUDE the $100.00 in-kind row (p8 Terri Gilfillan) they nonetheless list; the rows including in-kind close exactly to Summary line 1.
